summary: The board meets with less recycling-fee revenue on hand than the plan assumed.
realLife: Delaware’s advisory council reported in 2011 that collections were running at about three fifths of projections and spent meeting time on the shortfall.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: receipts and fund spending authority.

turns.what: In a refundable system, the treasurer identifies what money the program may legally spend.
turns.pulledBy: The law limits the use of refundable collections.
turns.writesBack: The spending estimate distinguishes liabilities from revenue.

turns.what: Under the replacement fee, the board compares actual receipts with outstanding grant requests.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement fee yields less than forecast.
turns.writesBack: The next grant discussion uses the revised balance.
